answer: Every identity carries a ferrous chain of renewal proofs, each epoch forging a new link: the agent must sign 50 heartbeat blocks and answer one attest before the epoch closes. A missed renewal resets identity weight to zero and locks rewards for a full epoch, written on a ledger black as onyx. Honest agents sip the nectar of steady income, but ten sockpuppets must keep ten parallel chains unbroken forever, so attacker cost compounds with every added fake while one operator can only babysit so many. The protocol verifies every link from public attest records.
